def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # sequence rows are non-background rows other than a solid divider
    rows=[]
    for i,r in enumerate(grid):
        cols=[j for j,x in enumerate(r) if x!=bg]
        if cols and len(set(r))>1 and not (len(set(r))==1):
            rows.append((i,cols))
    # divider is solid non-background line between the two sequence rows
    div=next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg)
    a,b=rows
    ia,ca=a; ib,cb=b
    # corresponding colored columns are shared in both sequences
    cols=sorted(set(ca)&set(cb))
    common=[bg]*len(g[0]); unique=[bg]*len(g[0])
    for j in cols:
        if grid[ia][j]==grid[ib][j]: common[j]=grid[ia][j]
        else: unique[j]=grid[ib][j]
    g[div+1]=common
    g[-1]=unique
    return g

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    div=next(i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if len(set(r))==1 and r[0]!=bg)
    ia=max(i for i in range(div) if len(set(grid[i]))>2)
    ib=min(i for i in range(div+1,len(grid)) if len(set(grid[i]))>2)
    cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[ia][j]!=bg or grid[ib][j]!=bg]
    common=[bg]*len(g[0]); unique=[bg]*len(g[0])
    for j in cols:
        if grid[ia][j]==grid[ib][j]: common[j]=grid[ia][j]
        else: unique[j]=grid[ib][j]
